faq.q: How much does tree removal cost in Macon?
faq.a: It depends on the tree's size, how close it is to the house or power lines, and whether a truck can reach it. Small trees can be a few hundred dollars; large trees near a house cost more. The pro gives you a free quote before any work starts.

faq.q: How fast can someone come out?
faq.a: For storm damage, pros try to come the same day. For regular jobs, most quotes happen within a few days. Pick the day and time that suit you in the form and the pro confirms by phone.

faq.q: Do I need a permit to remove a tree?
faq.a: Rules vary. Historic districts, some neighborhoods and HOAs have their own. Ask the pro, and check with Macon-Bibb County if you are not sure.

faq.q: Will my homeowners insurance pay for it?
faq.a: Often only when a storm drops a tree on a covered building like the house or a fence. Check your policy; the pro can photograph the damage for your claim.
